newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Buy Ionics says Sun Hung Kai.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Buy Ionics says Sun Hung Kai.

text.p: Manila brokerage firm Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phil) Inc on Monday rated Ionics Circuits Inc a buy on expectations of good earnings for 1996 and 1997.
In its recommendation, Sun Hung Kai said the semiconductor firm will post 380 million pesos in net income for 1996 due to increased production volume.
"As a result, retained earnings would jump to 530 million pesos, exceeding the capital stock of 344 million pesos. Hence, a potential dividend play," Sun Hung Kai said.

With its plant operating at full capacity this year, the company is expected to generate 495 pesos in net income by year-end, 30.26 percent more than the 1996 estimate of 380 million pesos, Sun Hung Kai added.
For the first nine months of 1996, Ionics reported net income of 269.804 million pesos against 194.45 million pesos in the year-ago period. Full year 1995 profits were at 284.8 million pesos.
